items.title: Jim Hall — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Gerry, Paul Desmond, Hank Jones, Milt Hinton… I’m drawing a blank on the drummer’s name. … But anyway, we rehearsed and Gerry wrote some nice arrangements for it.

ctx.x: He was great. I was, you know, a huge fan. I just… but I can’t… Oh, yeah. There was… somebody threw together a bunch of musicians for some kinda something

on Long Island. There were some really good players. Coleman Hawkins… Hank Jones played piano. That was funny ‘cause the piano was terribly out of tune. And Hank was such a marvelous… He, somehow when he… by the time he finished, it sounded like it was in tune. He just would choose notes that worked.
